Theorem
[Upper bound for the heat kernel for an evolving metric] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0376, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0377 ↗ lem:chow-iii-heat-kernel-average-gaussian-decay ↗ lem:chow-iii-noncompact-heat-kernel-semigroup 1. ch26:26.25\group Heat Kernel Upper Bounds

There are constants $C_3,C_4<\infty $, with the dependence specified in the source, such that \[ H(x,\tau ;y,v)\le \frac{C_3e^{-d_{\widetilde g}(x,y)^2/(C_4(\tau -v))}}{\Vol _{\widetilde g}^{1/2}B_{\widetilde g}(x,\sqrt{(\tau -v)/2}) \Vol _{\widetilde g}^{1/2}B_{\widetilde g}(y,\sqrt{(\tau -v)/2})}. \]
Proof

\sketch Split the semigroup identity at $\rho =(\tau +v)/2$, distribute half the Gaussian distance between its two factors, and apply Cauchy–Schwarz and the two weighted $L^2$ estimates.

□
